notes.source: The feed card's words, in both clients (#658). `npm run copy:generate` writes the two files named above from this one; neither client may spell these strings itself, because Arabic writes a word's marks in more than one order and a retyped label is one an exact-text test later misses (ADR-0098).
notes.placeholders: `authorLink` carries `{name}`: the card substitutes the publisher's name, so the sentence stays in one place on both clients.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a copy key the reference component (`app/community/_components/post-card.tsx`) does not render - the site is the design the app is measured against.
